0.5.4-beta / versionCode 21 — reuse the connection before slot reads
Date: 2026-10-17

Delivery
  APK: nikon-usb-0.5.4-beta-debug.apk
  Size: 2724473 bytes
  SHA-256: cd1780d4401b50ed31e931ccbade1713b77473a73ffc85c9e54fb8187ebaa37b
  scripts/build-apk.ps1 completed; v2/v3 signatures verified.

Problem and behavior
  User reports 0.5.3 can import wirelessly, but Wi-Fi disconnected once while
  reading capability/empty slots. This is a user report without an independently
  reviewed full camera trace, not proof of a specific AP firmware trigger.
  Remaining code gaps: closing album sockets before new preset reads, and closing
  standalone settings detection before later preset selection. Both are removed.
  Same-endpoint album work drains before a one-way transfer to a distinct PC
  owner. Its sockets, open session, event reader and transaction IDs are preserved.
  Old album handles cannot read/write/reconnect; old close/abort cannot affect
  the new owner. Settings read-only detection keeps the owned session even when
  registration is not advertised. Root navigation keeps 10-second Standard reads.
  Selecting a preset fully refreshes DeviceInfo/capability/Standard/nine slots.
  Actual import still checks required operations, all slots and target, sends
  at most one registration and verifies exact readback before session closure.
  Explicit reconnection, changed endpoint, USB, recovery and cancellation release
  connections. Close diagnostics preserve first handshake/command/event cause.
  Pending handoffs have an atomic holder, cancellation/destruction close, executor
  rejection cleanup and CAS retirement; shutdownNow cannot leak queued ownership.

Automated checks
  tests/run.ps1: 8690 passed, including PTP/IP 3288 and AlbumController 82.
  tests/run-probe.ps1: 6938 passed:
    ordinary probe 685; read-only 453; USB copy/adaptation 1004; wireless 4796.
  Total current run: 15628. Historical library checks are not added.
  New deterministic tests cover in-flight half-frame draining, old queued work
  and callbacks, stale photos, cancelled handoffs/claims, repeated transfer/claim,
  old controller closure, preview pin cleanup, event ping/EOF/bad frames, endpoint
  mismatch, fresh snapshot failure, no registration capability and one-write paths.
  Mixed synthetic UI server self-tests and existing mode checks passed.
  Independent source review found one queued-owner leak, fixed with the atomic
  holder above; final review reports no remaining P1/P2.

Final APK foreground UI verification
  Pixel 9 Android 17/API 37 temporary read-only emulator, 1080x2424.
  PreviewTone.NCP added before the final connection. Server mode:
    --picture-control-album-import-synthetic
  Strictly loopback 127.0.0.1:15744, emulator 10.0.2.2:15744, zero photos,
  virtual slots only in process memory. CloseSession makes new Init requests fail.
  No camera/physical Wi-Fi access in the server. One complete foreground chain:
    Album enumeration -> settings detection handoff -> back to preset root ->
    selected preset fresh scan -> confirmation -> import -> exact readback.
  Open 01:55:13.785Z to Close 01:57:29.769Z: 135.984 seconds.
  Only one InitCommand/InitEvent/Open/Close, all session=1, tx1-49 continuous.
  tx1/2 album enumeration; tx3 DeviceInfo/4 capability/5 Standard/6-14 nine slots;
  settings kept 39.947 seconds, timed Standard tx15-17;
  tx18 DeviceInfo/19 capability/20 Standard/21-29 nine slots;
  confirmation held 54.974 seconds, timed Standard tx30-34;
  tx35 DeviceInfo/36 capability/37-45 nine slots/46 final target recheck;

  Eight timed heartbeats. Server's heartbeats=9 also counts refreshed Standard.
  Write and readback both 614 bytes with identical SHA-256:
    07434caabeee4bc79727b3cbfd105e037659933866e5aada76419db8745bb199
  UI displayed saved to C1/readback verified. No intermediate transport_closed,

Exploratory background limitation
  In an earlier run, album->settings handoff and heartbeats passed; subsequently
  opening external document selection put the app in background. Transport
  closed without CloseSession and without writes. Cause not established; this
  run is not counted as successful end-to-end or background stability evidence.
  docs/device-review/wireless-0.5.4-background-picker.log preserves it separately.
  Final foreground run above used an already-added preset and a new server.

  adb install --user 0 -r succeeded, preserving application data.
  versionCode 21, versionName 0.5.4-beta, installed=true.
  Installed base.apk SHA-256 matches the delivery hash above.
  No synthetic preset was added to the phone, no foreground manipulation or
  camera operation during install. This version still needs Z6II retesting.

Limits
  Synthetic success proves application session continuity on the tested foreground
  path, not Nikon AP policy, firmware acceptance, Wi-Fi quality or pairing.
  Existing strict NCP subset and template approximation remain unchanged.
  No new photo-effect, background, TalkBack, tablet or performance certification.
